Use the provided ROAD TO HOME VILLAGE reference as the environment reference.

Warm fading sunset light spreads across the mountain landscape.

The army is actively marching toward the village.

No battle.

No attack yet.

No burning village.

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural walking movement.

Realistic armor and weapon weight.

Natural cloth, hair, and environmental physics.

Large-scale cinematic army movement.

No text.

No logo.

A LARGE ALLIED ARMY is marching along the mountain road toward the village at sunset.

Riven and Ally Soldier begin near the front section of the marching formation.

At first, both of them walk normally with the army.

Riven gradually begins to slow down.

The army does NOT stop with her.

SOLDIERS behind Riven continue marching forward and begin passing her on both sides.

More and more soldiers move past Riven as she becomes slower.

Ally Soldier notices what is happening and gradually slows down near her.

Ally Soldier remains close to her.

The army continues moving.

A continuous stream of SOLDIERS passes around them and continues toward the village.

Riven has silently decided that she cannot continue marching with them.


=== SCENE ===

The military column is substantial and long.

DOZENS OF SOLDIERS are visible.

The formation stretches far down the road and deep into the background.

Riven and Ally Soldier are walking near the front section of the formation.

They move naturally with the army.

Riven is quiet.

As the march continues, Riven begins walking slightly slower.

Ally Soldier continues beside her at first.

The army keeps moving forward.

Riven slows down further.

SOLDIERS coming from behind begin walking past her.

Some pass on her left.

Others pass on her right.

Riven continues becoming slower while the flow of soldiers around her becomes increasingly noticeable.

Ally Soldier notices Riven falling behind.

He looks toward her.

He also begins slowing down.

Riven finally stops walking completely.

Ally Soldier stops nearby.

The army does NOT stop.

DOZENS OF SOLDIERS continue marching past Riven and Ally Soldier on both sides.

The moving army gradually separates around the two stationary characters and continues forward along the road toward the village.

Keep the contrast visually clear:

Riven is completely still.

Ally Soldier remains near her.

The army continues flowing around them.

Soldiers who have already passed them continue farther down the road.

Many more soldiers are still approaching from behind.

Riven watches the army continuing toward her home.

She says nothing.

She does not draw her sword.

She does not attack anyone.

The soldiers do not attack Riven.

End with Riven standing motionless on the road while the large army continues marching around and past her under the fading sunset.

CUT.

Riven has stopped marching with the army.

Ally Soldier has stopped near her.

A large number of SOLDIERS have already passed them and continue toward the village.

Many more SOLDIERS still remain behind them on the road.

The army has NOT stopped as a whole.

Riven has not drawn her sword.

Riven has not attacked anyone.

No combat has started.

The village has not been attacked yet.

Riven is now physically separated from the movement of the army.

Scene 17 begins from this situation.


=== MOOD ===

Quiet.

Tense.

Cinematic.

Somber sunset atmosphere.

A sense of an irreversible decision approaching.

THE ARMY KEEPS MOVING.
